title: Road to Super Bowl LXI Press Briefing 9/21/26
description:
Super Bowl LXI is officially heading to SoFi Stadium on February 14, 2027. The Valentine’s Day matchup will bring more than football to the Los Angeles region.

The event is projected to generate approximately $400+ million in economic impact for the region. Through the Super Bowl LXI procurement program, local businesses will also have opportunities to compete for contracts connected to the event.

The impact will extend beyond game day through “For The Love Of The Game,” the Super Bowl LXI legacy initiative focused on creating more opportunities for young people across the Los Angeles region to stay active and healthy.

The initiative includes 27 Champion Grants for 2027 supporting youth-serving organizations and programs, including flag football, coaching, equipment, transportation, and access to places to play.

Super Bowl LXI may last just one day, but organizers are working to make its community impact last well beyond the final whistle.
